text:
Talia (AE): dropping LumenFold POC redlines. procurement wants net60, split invoicing (US entity + EU subsidiary), PO before countersign, explicit test-data deletion, and an HSM attestation. they also asked for a completed security questionnaire. attaching redline.
Omar - Legal: quick q - are they handling regulated data or just PII? and which Redwood entity should sign?
Talia (AE): mostly PII and some GDPR-sensitive hashed identifiers. they want Redwood US to sign, but EU invoicing for EU subsidiary. procurement insisted on HSM attestation in the MSA.
Ben (SE): technical note: Hosted supports CMK (customer-managed keys) and we can provide procedural attestation plus SOC reports. hardware HSM attestation is only available with Dedicated + HSM-backed KMS.
Lina (Presales): suggestion: offer a short Dedicated trial (30 days) to meet attestation and provide predictable p95 latency. we'll include cost delta and EU-region options.
Mei (Finance): net60 is unusual but OK for enterprise POC if PO and billing contacts (US + EU AP) are provided before countersign. split invoicing requires entity-specific order lines and tax IDs.
Viktor (Security): security questionnaire inbound: they want subprocessors list, data flow map, and EU data residency for embeddings. we need to confirm embeddings vendor and whether we can isolate EU workload.
Omar - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA 1 they asked for p95 <130ms for inference during POC (2) KMS/HSM indemnity and attestations (3) split-invoice wording and tax clause (4) subprocessor & data residency guarantees.
Ben (SE): p95 <130ms realistic only on Dedicated in EU region for larger models. Hosted EU region likely p95 ~200ms. propose language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs; firm p95 SLA and regional isolation available via Dedicated deployment addendum."
Talia (AE): procurement also wants signature routing: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Customer CISO -> Redwood Exec. they requested countersign within 5 business days and scanned signed orderform.
Mei (Finance): 5 business days ok if PO(s) and billing contacts for both entities are provided. we'll set up split invoice templates; need tax IDs and billing addresses. e-sign OK.
Omar - Legal: propose compromise clause for the orderform: firm regional isolation and p95 SLA require Dedicated addendum; Hosted includes procedural KMS attestation and SOC reports. escalate to Product Security if they insist on hardware cert for Hosted.
ContractBot: ACTIONS SUMMARY:
- Legal (Omar) to draft MSA reply with Dedicated addendum fallback, split-invoice clause, and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Ben) to attach perf matrix for Hosted vs Dedicated in EU and Dedicated trial pricing (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Talia) to collect PO(s), US + EU billing contacts, tax IDs, and signer names (ETA today).
- Finance (Mei) to prepare split-invoice templates and confirm net60 terms on orderform (ETA EOD).
- Security (Viktor) to start security questionnaire answers and confirm embeddings vendor & EU isolation feasibility (ETA 2 business days).
